maddeler.e:
أشتئي (form VIII)
# أَشْتَئِي (ʔaštaʔī) /ʔaʃ.ta.ʔiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
# أَشْتَئِيَ (ʔaštaʔiya) /ʔaʃ.ta.ʔi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
